title: Frozen artifact directory aliases fail to protect history cycles
symptom: Windows-style directory references in frozen text are missed by history retention
trigger: A retained artifact names the cycles directory with mixed case or backslash separators
expected: Equivalent references protect every matching cycle in preview and apply
actual: Three referenced cycles are eligible and deleted with complete:true
impact: P2: referenced proof can be removed despite its retained protection source

notes.text: status: open -> verified. Structured and plaintext reference paths share normalization; equivalent frozen artifact aliases no longer expose protected cycles to pruning. Eight fixture variants and all19 history tests passed.
The final full verification also passes the new frozen-reference alias preservation case and all222tests; all original failures and proof remain retained.
